instruction: Help me set Thunderbird to compose emails in plain text by disabling HTML composition.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to disable HTML composition in Thunderbird, forcing plain text email composition. The evaluator checks that the preference 'mail.identity.default.compose_html' is set to false in the prefs.js file. This follows the same pattern as the original task but tests a different mail composition preference.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable HTML composition in Thunderbird
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly retrieves the Thunderbird prefs.js file containing preference settings
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses prefs.js and checks that 'mail.identity.default.compose_html' equals false
Expected value semantically correct - checking mail.identity.default.compose_html=false is the right preference for disabling HTML composition
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before verification
Complete coverage - evaluator checks the exact preference needed to verify the task completion
Metric handles None case correctly (returns 0.0 if file retrieval fails)
Data flow is correct: getter returns Optional[str], metric accepts str and handles None
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Type annotation shows Union[Optional[str], List[Optional[str]]] but in practice returns Optional[str] when multi=False. This is functionally correct but could be more precise in type hints.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
